ops.value: Bring out the burgers when Julius bails Vincent out of jail.

ops.old: Potato skins loaded with cheddar and bacon. One embryo split in two.
ops.new: Potato skins loaded with cheddar and bacon, one spud split two ways, like the twins.

ops.old: Cheeseburgers with roasted green chile. Griddled until done.
ops.new: Griddled beef cheeseburgers under roasted green chile, one big, one small.

ops.old: Hot turkey with mash and gravy. Vincent asks about Thanksgiving dinner.
ops.new: Hot turkey and mash under gravy, the family dinner the twins never got.

ops.old: Puffy fried sopaipillas with honey. We had six fathers.
ops.new: Puffy fried sopaipillas drizzled with honey, one for each of the six fathers.

ops.old: Thick vanilla milkshake from where Vincent finds they made the milkshake.
ops.new: Thick vanilla milkshake with two straws, one for each twin.
